verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ כִֽי־ יָבֹ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜יךָ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה הַבְּרָכָה֙ וְהַקְּלָלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ֙ אֶל־ לְבָבֶ֔ךָ בְּכָל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִדִּיחֲךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḵî- yā·ḇō·’ū ‘ā·le·ḵā kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh hab·bə·rā·ḵāh wə·haq·qə·lā·lāh ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wa·hă·šê·ḇō·ṯā ’el- lə·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā bə·ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer hid·dî·ḥă·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā šām·māh
verses.literal: When all these things come upon you the blessings and curses I have set before you and you call them to mind in all the nations to which the LORD your God . . . has banished you
verses.literalPt: E SERÁ que, sobrevindo-te todas estas coisas, a bênção ou a maldição, que tenho posto diante de ti, e te recordares delas entre todas as nações, para onde te lançar o SENHOR teu Deus,

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתָּ֞ עַד־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֣ בְקֹל֔וֹ כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם אַתָּ֣ה וּבָנֶ֔יךָ בְּכָל־ לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šaḇ·tā ‘aḏ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·šā·ma‘·tā ḇə·qō·lōw kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm ’at·tāh ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā bə·ḵāl lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵāl nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: and when you and your children return to the LORD your God and obey His voice with all your heart and all your soul according to everything I am giving you today
verses.literalPt: E te converteres ao SENHOR teu Deus, e deres ouvidos à sua voz, conforme a tudo o que eu te ordeno hoje, tu e teus filhos, com todo o teu coração, e com toda a tua alma,

verses.original: וְשָׁ֨ב יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ אֶת־ שְׁבוּתְךָ֖ וְרִחֲמֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁ֗ב וְקִבֶּצְךָ֙ מִכָּל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֱפִֽיצְךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šāḇ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’eṯ- šə·ḇū·ṯə·ḵā wə·ri·ḥă·me·ḵā wə·šāḇ wə·qib·beṣ·ḵā mik·kāl hā·‘am·mîm ’ă·šer hĕ·p̄î·ṣə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā šām·māh
verses.literal: then He . . . will restore you from captivity and have compassion on you . . . and gather you from all the nations to which the LORD your God . . . has scattered you
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR teu Deus te fará voltar do teu cativeiro, e se compadecerá de ti, e tornará a ajuntar-te dentre todas as nações entre as quais te espalhou o SENHOR teu Deus.

verses.original: אִם־ יִהְיֶ֥ה נִֽדַּחֲךָ֖ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם מִשָּׁ֗ם יְקַבֶּצְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וּמִשָּׁ֖ם יִקָּחֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yih·yeh nid·da·ḥă·ḵā biq·ṣêh haš·šā·mā·yim miš·šām yə·qab·beṣ·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ū·miš·šām yiq·qā·ḥe·ḵā
verses.literal: Even if you have been banished . . . to the farthest horizon He . . . . . . will gather you and return you from there
verses.literalPt: Ainda que os teus desterrados estejam na extremidade do céu, desde ali te ajuntará o SENHOR teu Deus, e te tomará dali;

verses.original: וֶהֱבִֽיאֲךָ֞ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֶל־ הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יָרְשׁ֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֑הּ וְהֵיטִֽבְךָ֥ וְהִרְבְּךָ֖ מֵאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: we·hĕ·ḇî·’ă·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- yā·rə·šū ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā wî·riš·tāh wə·hê·ṭiḇ·ḵā wə·hir·bə·ḵā mê·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: And the LORD your God will bring you into the land your fathers possessed and you will take possession of it He will cause you to prosper and multiply more than your fathers
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR teu Deus te trará à terra que teus pais possuíram, e a possuirás; e te fará bem, e te multiplicará mais do que a teus pais.

verses.original: וּמָ֨ל יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ אֶת־ לְבָבְךָ֖ וְאֶת־ לְבַ֣ב זַרְעֶ֑ךָ לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ בְּכָל־ לְבָבְךָ֥ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשְׁךָ֖ לְמַ֥עַן חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·māl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’eṯ- lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- lə·ḇaḇ zar·‘e·ḵā lə·’a·hă·ḇāh ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·ḵāl lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵāl nap̄·šə·ḵā lə·ma·‘an ḥay·ye·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants and you will love Him . . . with all your heart and with all your soul so that you may live
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR teu Deus circuncidará o teu coração, e o coração de tua descendência, para amares ao SENHOR teu Deus com todo o coração, e com toda a tua alma, para que vivas.

verses.original: וְנָתַן֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָאָל֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה עַל־ אֹיְבֶ֥יךָ וְעַל־ שֹׂנְאֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רְדָפֽוּךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯan Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’êṯ kāl- hā·’ā·lō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh ‘al- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā wə·‘al- śō·nə·’e·ḵā ’ă·šer rə·ḏā·p̄ū·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the LORD your God will put all these curses upon your enemies . . . who hate you and persecute you
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR teu Deus porá todas estas maldições sobre os teus inimigos, e sobre os teus odiadores, que te perseguiram.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה תָשׁ֔וּב וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֖ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ṯā·šūḇ wə·šā·ma‘·tā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wō·ṯāw ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: And you will again obey the voice of the LORD and follow all His commandments I am giving you today . . .
verses.literalPt: Converter-te-ás, pois, e darás ouvidos à voz do SENHOR; cumprirás todos os seus mandamentos que hoje te ordeno.

verses.original: וְהוֹתִֽירְךָ֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ בְּכֹ֣ל׀ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֗ךָ בִּפְרִ֨י בִטְנְךָ֜ וּבִפְרִ֧י בְהֶמְתְּךָ֛ וּבִפְרִ֥י אַדְמָתְךָ֖ לְטוֹבָ֑ה כִּ֣י׀ יָשׁ֣וּב יְהוָ֗ה לָשׂ֤וּשׂ עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ לְט֔וֹב כַּאֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֖שׂ עַל־ אֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṯî·rə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·ḵōl ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā bip̄·rî ḇiṭ·nə·ḵā ū·ḇip̄·rî ḇə·hem·tə·ḵā ū·ḇip̄·rî ’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā lə·ṭō·w·ḇāh kî yā·šūḇ Yah·weh lā·śūś ‘ā·le·ḵā lə·ṭō·wḇ ka·’ă·šer- śāś ‘al- ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: So the LORD your God will make you abound in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land Indeed, the LORD will again delight in your prosperity as He delighted in that of your fathers
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR teu Deus te fará prosperar em toda a obra das tuas mãos, no fruto do teu ventre, e no fruto dos teus animais, e no fruto da tua terra para o teu bem; porquanto o SENHOR tornará a alegrar-se em ti para te fazer bem, como se alegrou em teus pais,

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִשְׁמַ֗ע בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו הַכְּתוּבָ֕ה בְּסֵ֥פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֖ה הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֤י תָשׁוּב֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכָל־ לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî ṯiš·ma‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā liš·mōr miṣ·wō·ṯāw wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯāw hak·kə·ṯū·ḇāh bə·sê·p̄er hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zeh kî ṯā·šūḇ ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·ḵāl lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵāl nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: if you obey . . . the LORD your God by keeping His commandments and statutes that are written in this Book of the Law and if you turn to Him . . . with all your heart and with all your soul
verses.literalPt: Quando deres ouvidos à voz do SENHOR teu Deus, guardando os seus mandamentos e os seus estatutos, escritos neste livro da lei, quando te converteres ao SENHOR teu Deus com todo o teu coração, e com toda a tua alma.

verses.original: כִּ֚י הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם לֹֽא־ נִפְלֵ֥את הִוא֙ מִמְּךָ֔ וְלֹ֥א רְחֹקָ֖ה הִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: kî ham·miṣ·wāh haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm lō- nip̄·lêṯ hî mim·mə·ḵā wə·lō rə·ḥō·qāh hî
verses.literal: For this commandment I give you today is not too difficult . . . for you or beyond your reach . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque este mandamento, que hoje te ordeno, não te é encoberto, e tampouco está longe de ti.

verses.original: לֹ֥א בַשָּׁמַ֖יִם הִ֑וא לֵאמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַעֲלֶה־ לָּ֤נוּ הַשָּׁמַ֙יְמָה֙ וְיִקָּחֶ֣הָ לָּ֔נוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵ֥נוּ אֹתָ֖הּ וְנַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: lō ḇaš·šā·ma·yim hî lê·mōr mî ya·‘ă·leh- lā·nū haš·šā·may·māh wə·yiq·qā·ḥe·hā lā·nū wə·yaš·mi·‘ê·nū ’ō·ṯāh wə·na·‘ă·śen·nāh
verses.literal: It is not in heaven that you should need to ask Who will ascend into heaven to get it for us and proclaim it that we may obey it
verses.literalPt: Não está nos céus, para dizeres: Quem subirá por nós aos céus, que no-lo traga, e no-lo faça ouvir, para que o cumpramos?

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיָּ֖ם הִ֑וא לֵאמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַעֲבָר־ לָ֜נוּ אֶל־ עֵ֤בֶר הַיָּם֙ וְיִקָּחֶ֣הָ לָּ֔נוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵ֥נוּ אֹתָ֖הּ וְנַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yām hî lê·mōr mî ya·‘ă·ḇār- lā·nū ’el- ‘ê·ḇer hay·yām wə·yiq·qā·ḥe·hā lā·nū wə·yaš·mi·‘ê·nū ’ō·ṯāh wə·na·‘ă·śen·nāh
verses.literal: And it is not beyond the sea that you should need to ask Who will cross . . . . . . . . . the sea to get it for us and proclaim it that we may obey it
verses.literalPt: Nem tampouco está além do mar, para dizeres: Quem passará por nós além do mar, para que no-lo traga, e no-lo faça ouvir, para que o cumpramos?

verses.original: כִּֽי־ קָר֥וֹב אֵלֶ֛יךָ הַדָּבָ֖ר מְאֹ֑ד בְּפִ֥יךָ וּבִֽלְבָבְךָ֖ לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- qā·rō·wḇ ’ê·le·ḵā had·dā·ḇār mə·’ōḏ bə·p̄î·ḵā ū·ḇil·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā la·‘ă·śō·ṯōw
verses.literal: But the word is very near you it is in your mouth and in your heart so that you may obey it
verses.literalPt: Porque esta palavra está mui perto de ti, na tua boca, e no teu coração, para a cumprires.

verses.original: רְאֵ֨ה נָתַ֤תִּי לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֶת־ הַֽחַיִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַטּ֑וֹב וְאֶת־ הַמָּ֖וֶת וְאֶת־ הָרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh nā·ṯat·tî lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā hay·yō·wm ’eṯ- ha·ḥay·yîm wə·’eṯ- haṭ·ṭō·wḇ wə·’eṯ- ham·mā·weṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·rā‘
verses.literal: See I have set before you today life and prosperity as well as death and disaster
verses.literalPt: Vês aqui, hoje te tenho proposto a vida e o bem, e a morte e o mal;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוְּךָ֮ הַיּוֹם֒ לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת בִּדְרָכָ֔יו וְלִשְׁמֹ֛ר מִצְוֺתָ֥יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑יו וְחָיִ֣יתָ וְרָבִ֔יתָ וּבֵֽרַכְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה בָא־ שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm lə·’a·hă·ḇāh ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lā·le·ḵeṯ biḏ·rā·ḵāw wə·liš·mōr miṣ·wō·ṯāw wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯāw ū·miš·pā·ṭāw wə·ḥā·yî·ṯā wə·rā·ḇî·ṯā ū·ḇê·raḵ·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh ḇā- šām·māh lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: For I am commanding you today to love the LORD your God to walk in His ways and to keep His commandments statutes and ordinances so that you may live and increase and the LORD your God may bless you in the land that you are entering . . . to possess
verses.literalPt: Porquanto te ordeno hoje que ames ao SENHOR teu Deus, que andes nos seus caminhos, e que guardes os seus mandamentos, e os seus estatutos, e os seus juízos, para que vivas, e te multipliques, e o SENHOR teu Deus te abençoe na terra a qual entras a possuir.

verses.original: וְאִם־ יִפְנֶ֥ה לְבָבְךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א תִשְׁמָ֑ע וְנִדַּחְתָּ֗ וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֛יתָ לֵאלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים וַעֲבַדְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- yip̄·neh lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā wə·lō ṯiš·mā‘ wə·nid·daḥ·tā wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wî·ṯā lê·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tām
verses.literal: But if your heart turns away and you do not listen but are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them
verses.literalPt: Porém se o teu coração se desviar, e não quiseres dar ouvidos, e fores seduzido para te inclinares a outros deuses, e os servires,

verses.original: הִגַּ֤דְתִּי לָכֶם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י אָבֹ֖ד תֹּאבֵד֑וּן לֹא־ תַאֲרִיכֻ֤ן יָמִים֙ עַל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה עֹבֵר֙ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָבֹ֥א שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hig·gaḏ·tî lā·ḵem hay·yō·wm kî ’ā·ḇōḏ tō·ḇê·ḏūn lō- ṯa·’ă·rî·ḵun yā·mîm ‘al- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer ’at·tāh ‘ō·ḇêr ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên lå̄·ḇō šām·māh lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: I declare to you today that you will surely perish . . . you shall not prolong your days in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess
verses.literalPt: Então eu vos declaro hoje que, certamente, perecereis; não prolongareis os dias na terra a que vais, passando o Jordão, para que, entrando nela, a possuas;

verses.original: הַעִידֹ֨תִי בָכֶ֣ם הַיּוֹם֮ אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָרֶץ֒ הַחַיִּ֤ים וְהַמָּ֙וֶת֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לְפָנֶ֔יךָ הַבְּרָכָ֖ה וְהַקְּלָלָ֑ה וּבָֽחַרְתָּ֙ בַּֽחַיִּ֔ים לְמַ֥עַן תִּחְיֶ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה וְזַרְעֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·‘î·ḏō·ṯî ḇā·ḵem hay·yō·wm ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ha·ḥay·yîm wə·ham·mā·weṯ nā·ṯat·tî lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā hab·bə·rā·ḵāh wə·haq·qə·lā·lāh ū·ḇā·ḥar·tā ba·ḥay·yîm lə·ma·‘an tiḥ·yeh ’at·tāh wə·zar·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death blessing and cursing Therefore choose life so that you and your descendants may live
verses.literalPt: Os céus e a terra tomo hoje por testemunhas contra vós, de que te tenho proposto a vida e a morte, a bênção e a maldição; escolhe pois a vida, para que vivas, tu e a tua descendência,

verses.original: לְאַֽהֲבָה֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֥עַ בְּקֹל֖וֹ וּלְדָבְקָה־ ב֑וֹ כִּ֣י ה֤וּא חַיֶּ֙יךָ֙ וְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמֶ֔יךָ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת עַל־ הָאֲדָמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨ע יְהוָ֧ה לַאֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֛ם לְיִצְחָ֥ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֖ב לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·’a·hă·ḇāh ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā liš·mō·a‘ bə·qō·lōw ū·lə·ḏā·ḇə·qāh- ḇōw kî hū ḥay·ye·ḵā wə·’ō·reḵ yā·me·ḵā lā·še·ḇeṯ ‘al- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh la·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem
verses.literal: and that you may love the LORD your God obey Him . . . and hold fast to Him For He is your life and He will prolong your life . . . in the land that the LORD swore to give . . . to your fathers to Abraham Isaac and Jacob
verses.literalPt: Amando ao SENHOR teu Deus, dando ouvidos à sua voz, e achegando-te a ele; pois ele é a tua vida, e o prolongamento dos teus dias; para que fiques na terra que o SENHOR jurou a teus pais, a Abraão, a Isaque, e a Jacó, que lhes havia de dar.
